reference_revision.root_cause: A paper lookup targets the paper across arXiv formats; a repository lookup targets the official repository including files. Exact landing-page equality is too narrow. Other tasks keep exact known-page anchors.
reference_revision.scope: All methods for declared paper and repository tasks; frozen diagnostic preflight remains unchanged

collection_revision.root_cause: HTTP 200 can precede a truncated body; reference availability now also requires a successful transfer. Reference timeout is separate from API timing.
collection_revision.scope: Entire declared two-method, 24-query, three-round cohort rerun; previous calls preserved outside Git

cohort_revision.reason: Additional screenshot supplied after the 120-query cohort was frozen; separate complete paired cohort, never pooled into its timing distribution.
